rules.title: Gemini 2.5 model on Vertex AI
rules.event: Gemini 2.5 models retire on Vertex AI on October 20, 2026
fix: Point your app to a model Google lists as the upgrade, such as `gemini-3.8-flash`.
Test the features you need most.
Deploy the change as you usually do.
rules.hint: Point your app to a newer model Google lists, such as gemini-3.8-flash, and test it.

rules.title: GKE cluster on 1.31
rules.event: GKE 1.31 extended support ends October 22, 2026
fix: Upgrade the control plane yourself first: `gcloud container clusters upgrade CLUSTER_NAME --master --location=CONTROL_PLANE_LOCATION`
Then upgrade each node pool: `gcloud container clusters upgrade CLUSTER_NAME --node-pool=NODE_POOL_NAME --location=CONTROL_PLANE_LOCATION`
rules.hint: Upgrade the control plane, then each node pool, to 1.32 or newer before GKE does it for you.

rules.title: OpenAI model shut down Oct 23
rules.event: OpenAI shuts down gpt-4, gpt-3.5-turbo, o1 and o4-mini on October 23
fix: Change the model name to its substitute. Most go to `gpt-5.6-sol` or `gpt-5.6-terra`. `gpt-4.1-nano` goes to `gpt-5.6-luna`.
See what shuts down next: call `GET /v1/models` and read each model's `shutdown_date`.
Need an old model for longer? OpenAI says to ask its sales team about dedicated capacity.
rules.hint: Change the model name: most go to gpt-5.6-sol or gpt-5.6-terra; gpt-4.1-nano goes to gpt-5.6-luna.

rules.title: Pinpoint campaigns, segments or endpoints
rules.event: Amazon Pinpoint campaigns and segments end October 30, 2026
fix: Export your endpoints first: Make a segment with no filters, then export it to S3 or your computer.
rules.hint: Export your endpoints, then move campaigns to Connect outbound campaigns and email to Amazon SES.

rules.title: Amazon Pinpoint project
rules.event: Amazon Pinpoint campaigns and segments end October 30, 2026
fix: Export your endpoints first: Make a segment with no filters, then export it to S3 or your computer.
rules.hint: Export your endpoints, then move campaigns to Connect outbound campaigns and email to Amazon SES.

rules.title: Cloud Run functions on nodejs20
rules.event: Node.js 20 functions on Google Cloud: decommissioned October 30, 2026
fix: Set the runtime ID to `nodejs22` or `nodejs24`, then deploy again.
Pick `nodejs24` for longer support. Node.js 24 is decommissioned October 31, 2028, and Node.js 22 on October 31, 2027.
rules.hint: Set the runtime to nodejs22 or nodejs24 and deploy each function again.

rules.title: Lambda runtime python3.10
rules.event: AWS Lambda Python 3.10 runtime deprecated October 31, 2026
fix: Find your `python3.10` functions. Trusted Advisor lists them under AWS Lambda Functions Using Deprecated Runtimes.
Change the runtime to `python3.12`, `python3.13` or `python3.14`. Test it before you ship.
Use versions and aliases, so you can roll back.
Finish before July 29, 2027 (no new functions) and August 31, 2027 (no updates).
rules.hint: Set the runtime to python3.12, python3.13 or python3.14, rebuild layers and test before you deploy.

rules.title: Heroku stack heroku-22
rules.event: Heroku-22 stack: builds start failing November 1, 2026
fix: Try the new stack on a test or staging app first.
Set the stack: `heroku stack:set heroku-26 -a <app name>` (or `heroku-24`).
Build again: `git commit --allow-empty -m "Upgrading to heroku-26"`, then `git push heroku main`.
Set `"stack": "heroku-26"` in app.json, so Review Apps and Heroku CI use it too.
rules.hint: Set "stack": "heroku-26" (or heroku-24) and run heroku stack:set for each app, then build again.

rules.title: GitHub Actions runner macos-14
rules.event: GitHub Actions macos-14 runners retire November 2, 2026
fix: Search `.github/workflows` for `runs-on: macos-14`.
Change `macos-14` to `macos-latest`, `macos-15` or `macos-26`.
For large runners, use `macos-15-large`. For xlarge, use `macos-15-xlarge` or `macos-26-xlarge`.
rules.hint: Change the runner label to macos-15, macos-26 or macos-latest (keep -large or -xlarge if you use them).

rules.title: OpenSearch Service legacy version
rules.event: OpenSearch Service: old versions cost more from November 7, 2026
fix: Check the version of each domain: In the OpenSearch Service console, list your domains and their engine versions.
rules.hint: Upgrade the domain to the latest OpenSearch version to stop the Extended Support charge.

rules.title: Azure Functions in-process (dotnet)
rules.event: Azure Functions in-process model support ends November 10, 2026
fix: Find in-process apps: Look for function apps with FUNCTIONS_WORKER_RUNTIME set to dotnet. Microsoft gives a PowerShell script for this.
rules.hint: Move the app to the isolated worker model on .NET 10 and set FUNCTIONS_WORKER_RUNTIME to dotnet-isolated.

rules.title: .NET 8 or 9 container image
rules.event: .NET 8 and .NET 9 end of support: November 10, 2026
fix: Find apps on .NET 8 and 9: Check the TargetFramework in each project file. Look for net8.0 and net9.0.
rules.hint: Use the .NET 10 images (tag 10.0) and set TargetFramework to net10.0.

rules.title: .NET 8 or 9 target framework
rules.event: .NET 8 and .NET 9 end of support: November 10, 2026
fix: Find apps on .NET 8 and 9: Check the TargetFramework in each project file. Look for net8.0 and net9.0.
rules.hint: Set TargetFramework to net10.0, update NuGet packages and build with the .NET 10 SDK.

rules.title: .NET 8 or 9 SDK pinned
rules.event: .NET 8 and .NET 9 end of support: November 10, 2026
fix: Find apps on .NET 8 and 9: Check the TargetFramework in each project file. Look for net8.0 and net9.0.
rules.hint: Pin a .NET 10 SDK in global.json and set TargetFramework to net10.0.

rules.title: SSH to bitbucket.org
rules.event: Bitbucket Cloud SSH moves to ssh.bitbucket.org by November 12, 2026
fix: Run `git remote -v` in each repo. Look for `git@bitbucket.org:`.
Switch it: `git remote set-url origin git@ssh.bitbucket.org:<workspace>/<repo>.git`

On the first connect, check the host key fingerprint against the list Atlassian publishes, then type yes. In CI, add the keys first: `curl -s https://bitbucket.org/site/ssh | sed 's/bitbucket.org/ssh.bitbucket.org/' >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts`
Change SSH links in CI and scripts. If a firewall limits SSH, allow ssh.bitbucket.org on port 22.
rules.hint: Use git@ssh.bitbucket.org:<workspace>/<repo>.git and add the new host key to known_hosts.

rules.title: Auth0 Rule or Hook in Terraform
rules.event: Auth0 Rules and Hooks reach end of life November 18, 2026
fix: List your Rules and Hooks: In the Auth0 Dashboard, note every active Rule and Hook and what it does.
rules.hint: Move each Rule and Hook to an Action on the Post-Login trigger, then turn the Rule off.

rules.title: Azure OpenAI o-series deployment
rules.event: Azure OpenAI o1, o3, o3-mini and o4-mini retire November 19, 2026
fix: List your deployments: Check each Azure OpenAI deployment: model, version and deployment type.
rules.hint: Move o1 and o3 to gpt-5.6-sol, and o3-mini and o4-mini to gpt-5.6-terra. Provisioned deployments do not upgrade by themselves.

rules.title: EKS cluster on 1.31 (eksctl)
rules.event: Amazon EKS 1.31 extended support ends November 26, 2026
fix: Check cluster versions: In the EKS console, look at the Kubernetes version of each cluster. Note any on 1.31 to 1.34.
rules.hint: Upgrade the cluster to 1.32 or newer. After the date AWS may upgrade it, and that cannot be rolled back.

fix: Check cluster versions: In the EKS console, look at the Kubernetes version of each cluster. Note any on 1.31 to 1.34.
rules.hint: Upgrade the cluster to 1.32 or newer. After the date AWS may upgrade it, and that cannot be rolled back.

rules.title: Claude Sonnet 4.5 on the Claude API
rules.event: Claude Sonnet 4.5 retires on the Claude API on November 30, 2026
fix: Find calls to the old model: Search your code and settings for claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929.
rules.hint: Change the model to claude-sonnet-5-5 and test your prompts.

rules.title: Claude Sonnet 4.5 on the Claude API
rules.event: Claude Sonnet 4.5 retires on the Claude API on November 30, 2026
fix: Find calls to the old model: Search your code and settings for claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929.
rules.hint: Change the model to claude-sonnet-5-5 and test your prompts.

rules.title: OpenAI Evals or reusable prompt
rules.event: OpenAI Evals, reusable prompts and Agent Builder shut down November 30
fix: Copy your evals before October 31: After October 31 they are read-only. Save the test data and grader settings you use.
rules.hint: Move prompt text into your code, save the evals you need (they go read-only first) and plan the move to Promptfoo.

rules.title: OpenAI GPT-5, o3 or image snapshot
rules.event: OpenAI retires early GPT-5 snapshots, o3 and old image models
fix: List the models you call: Search for gpt-5-2025-08-07, gpt-5-mini, gpt-5-nano, gpt-5-pro, o3, o3-pro and older gpt-image names.
rules.hint: Move to gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra or gpt-5.6-luna; image models go to gpt-image-2.5-sunburst or gpt-image-2.5-flare.

rules.title: Prisma Accelerate connection
rules.event: Prisma Accelerate is retired on December 1, 2026
fix: Find Accelerate connection strings: Search your env files for prisma+postgres://accelerate.prisma-data.net.
rules.hint: Switch to a pooled connection or the serverless driver, and remove cacheStrategy from your queries.

rules.title: Vagrant box from the public registry
rules.event: HCP Vagrant and the public box registry end December 31, 2026
fix: List the boxes you use: Check each Vagrantfile for config.vm.box names that come from the public registry.
rules.hint: Host the boxes you use somewhere else (for example S3) and set config.vm.box_url.

rules.title: Cloud SQL on MySQL 8.0
rules.event: Cloud SQL for MySQL 8.0 costs extra from January 1, 2027
fix: List your instances and versions: In the console, open Cloud SQL and check the database version of each instance and replica.
rules.hint: Plan the upgrade to a newer MySQL major version, or budget for the extended support fee per vCPU.

rules.title: Custom Search JSON API call
rules.event: Google Custom Search JSON API ends for current users January 1, 2027
fix: List what uses the API: Find every app, script and plugin that calls the Custom Search JSON API with your key.
rules.hint: Move to Vertex AI Search (up to 50 domains) or another search API.

rules.title: Windows Server 2016 image
rules.event: Windows Server 2016 support ends January 12, 2027
fix: List your 2016 servers: Find every server and VM on Windows Server 2016, and what runs on it.
rules.hint: Move these servers, VM images and containers to a newer Windows Server version.

rules.title: App Engine first-gen runtime
rules.event: App Engine first-generation runtimes end January 31, 2027
fix: Find apps on old runtimes: In the console, open App Engine and check the runtime of each service and version.
rules.hint: Move each service to a newer runtime. After the date you cannot deploy on these runtimes.

rules.title: Exchange Online EWS endpoint
rules.event: Exchange Online turns off EWS for good on April 1, 2027
fix: Find what still uses EWS: Open the EWS usage reports in the Microsoft 365 admin center. List each app and script.
rules.hint: Move the app or script to Microsoft Graph.

rules.title: Opsgenie resource or API
rules.event: Opsgenie shuts down April 5, 2027, and unmoved data is deleted
fix: Save your setup first: Write down schedules, escalation rules, integrations and routing before you move anything.
rules.hint: Move to Jira Service Management (Settings > Plan your move) before your data is deleted.
